kicker: JetBrains' Mellum2.1, read from its weights

scenes.headline: How a 12B coding model runs like a small one
scenes.sub: Mellum2.1: the same architecture, then a summer of RL
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Marmot! Today, a twelve billion parameter coding model that reads a fifth of its weights per token.

scenes.text: Keep the fast architecture untouched, and spend the whole release on reinforcement learning in real repositories.
scenes.say: The idea: leave the fast architecture as it was, and spend the release on reinforcement learning in real repositories.

steps.say: Each token reaches a layer, and a small router scores it.
There are sixty-four narrow experts per layer.
Only the top eight run, and their outputs are summed: about two and a half billion parameters per token.

scenes.title: Three layers in four look back 1,024 tokens

steps.label: full attention
steps.say: A full attention layer keeps keys and values for every past token, forever.

steps.label: sliding window
steps.say: Three layers in four use a sliding window instead, keeping only the last thousand and twenty-four tokens.

steps.label: the 7 full layers
steps.say: Only seven layers keep growing, so at long context the cache is about four times smaller.

scenes.title: What changed: everything after pre-training
scenes.say: None of that changed. The training after it did.

items.text: Real repositories, shell and file tools
items.say: The model works in real repositories, with a shell and file tools.
It is rewarded when the tests pass.

left.title: Clip the update
items: Their gradient is cut to zero
left.say: The usual loss clips the update, so rare, decisive tokens are silenced first.

right.title: Clip the weight
right.say: The new one caps the weight instead. Every token keeps pushing.

scenes.title: SWE-bench Verified, JetBrains' harness
scenes.note: self-reported, same pipeline for all four
scenes.say: On SWE-bench Verified, from two to forty-seven. Qwen three point five nine B still edges it, on all three agentic tests.

steps.say: The speed was measured with short prompts and short answers: a code completion shape, not an agent turn.
Under full load, it serves almost twice the tokens of that rival.

scenes.text: Speed comes from routing and a short window. Agent skill came from reinforcement learning in real repositories.
scenes.mark: Agent skill came from reinforcement learning

recap: Sliding windows keep the cache small
RL in real repos made it an agent
scenes.say: To recap: eight of sixty-four experts, a small cache, and reinforcement learning that made it an agent.
